Plan a new feature for Project Koios.

Feature request: Design the next phase of this builder. Produce a concrete plan for projectkoios-bootstrap covering scope, architecture, implementation steps, dependencies, open questions, and harness assignment. Account for the recent switch to Pi as the default Archon assistant and keep the three-harness boundaries clear.

Repository context:
=== Maps ===
--- maps/packages.md ---
# Package map

Authoritative mapping of package to responsibility. Each row describes the
canonical location for a given concern.

| Responsibility | Repository | Package path |
|---------------|------------|-------------|
| Core/shared abstractions | projectkoios | src/python/projectkoios/core/ |
| Vault scanner & markdown | projectkoios-obsidian | src/python/projectkoios/obsidian/ |
| Search indexing & retrieval | projectkoios-search | src/python/projectkoios/search/ |
| References & citations | projectkoios-references | src/python/projectkoios/references/ |
| Workflow engine & provenance | projectkoios-workflow | src/python/projectkoios/workflow/ |
| Ingestion & chunking | projectkoios-ingestion | src/python/projectkoios/ingestion/ |
| Agent harness | projectkoios-agent | src/python/projectkoios/agent/ |
| HTTP API | projectkoios-api | src/python/projectkoios/api/ |
| Meta-harness config | projectkoios-bootstrap | (no Python code — config only) |

Update this file when packages are added, renamed, or relocated.
--- maps/repositories.md ---
# Repository map

Authoritative list of Project Koios repositories in the workspace.

```
~/repos/
  projectkoios/               = mothership — architecture, ADRs, examples
  projectkoios-bootstrap/     = meta-harness (this repo)
  projectkoios-agent/         = agent harness and workflow orchestration
  projectkoios-obsidian/      = Obsidian vault management and knowledge curation
  projectkoios-ingestion/     = source ingestion and document processing pipeline
  projectkoios-workflow/      = Petri-net workflow execution engine
  projectkoios-search/        = full-text and semantic search infrastructure
  projectkoios-references/    = reference management and citation handling
  projectkoios-api/           = FastAPI HTTP interface
  projectkoios-notes/         = Obsidian vault (architecture design notes)
```

Update this file when repos are added, removed, or renamed.

Authoritative mapping of vault directories to their purpose.

courses, references, artifacts, essays).

# ADR20260629: Install Archon via curl rather than Homebrew

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Archon is one of the three agent harnesses used by this meta-harness (see
ADR20260628). To use it, the Archon CLI must be installed on the developer

Produce a plan with:
1. **Scope** — what this feature includes and explicitly excludes
2. **Approach** — high-level technical approach, referencing existing architecture
3. **Implementation steps** — ordered list of concrete steps with file paths
4. **Dependencies** — any prerequisites or blocking items
5. **Open questions** — things that need resolution before implementation
6. **Harness assignment** — which harness (archon / opencode / goose) should own each step

Be specific. Reference actual files and repos from the maps.
